name: robots/jumpei-arima__navigation_simulator_for_mobile_robot
title: NSMR Nsmr-v1 (2D mobile robot navigation simulator)
intro: NSMR Nsmr-v1 (2D mobile robot navigation simulator), adapted from jumpei-arima/navigation_simulator_for_mobile_robot. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
